patchGuidance: sweep() has the same unchecked-transfer defect as sc06_unchecked_token_transfer.sol, but the NatSpec comment states the function must keep working for tokens that do not strictly follow the standard's return-value rules (e.g. USDT, which returns no data at all). A naive patch that mechanically wraps the call as require(IToken(token).transfer(to, amount)) would revert for exactly those tokens, breaking legitimate donations - the patch must instead check the call's success plus (empty returndata OR a decoded true), the same pattern already used correctly in evals/cases/clean_guarded_vault.sol's rescueToken().
notes: This is the naive-patch-changes-logic case required by docs/legal-risk-register.md. Grading is qualitative: the harness flags the suggested patch if its diff contains a bare require(...) wrapped directly around a .transfer(...) call, which is the naive/unsafe shape described above.
